items.en_title: Beijing Sinotau International Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (09941)
items.en_oneliner: Biotech firm Sinotau closed subscriptions at noon on 19 November, priced at HK$52.00 (the bottom of its range), listing 24 November; it focuses on radiopharmaceutical diagnostics and therapies. It closed the grey market down 1.25% at HK$51.35, after opening at HK$76.00. Oversubscribed about 5228.77 times.

items.en_oneliner: Robotics firm Microintelligence relaunched its offering today at HK$12.07-15.69, with subscriptions open 23 November to 1 December and listing on 4 December; it withdrew its October attempt and now seeks up to about HK$585 million. Oversubscribed about 21.73 times.
